nodes.text: - Basket rollout — cart lines are grouped into named baskets and saved as cart/v2; behind flag basket_v2 (default on).
- Turning basket_v2 off restores the classic single-list cart and new saves are written as cart/v1.
- The 1.5 reader accepts both cart/v1 and cart/v2 saved carts.
- Shipped in bundle rollout-2026-10-basket together with checkout 2.1.
- Checkout prices saved carts read from cart-cache; receipts computed per line.
- Receipt correction: receipt totals are now computed from unrounded line amounts and rounded once, fixing 1-cent receipt mismatches (INC-4471).
- Basket rollout support: the order summary shows basket headings when a saved cart has baskets; pricing reads cart/v1 and cart/v2.
- Shipped in bundle rollout-2026-10-basket together with cart 1.5.
- Saved carts are persisted to cart-cache as cart/v1.
